name: Grade 8 IT Practice: May Week 11 - Testing and Revision
description: Practice words for Grade 8 first-trimester work.

words.definition: User or peer comments about portfolio navigation, readability, links, or media.
words.example: Feedback showed that the menu labels needed to be clearer.

words.definition: How easy text is to read.
words.example: Readability improved after the student shortened the paragraph.

words.definition: Text that describes an image for accessibility.
words.example: Alt text described the poster image for screen readers.

words.definition: A way to open a web page or file.
words.example: The broken link was fixed before publishing the page.

words.definition: A changed version made after review.
words.example: The revision changed the homepage after peer review.

words.definition: To make a site or work available to others.
words.example: The student can publish the final portfolio for the teacher to view.
